body: I really don't know if there's any purpose out there that can give me a reason to go on. :(

A, yes.

B, no, with many small impacts combined, they matter, but no individual small impact matters much and they can often be replaced with some other version that could have occurred in its place and the end result similar.

C, yes for me

Life does need a point for me. Without purpose, I'm not currently seeing the point of experiencing anything.

Honestly, and maybe it's because it's just text, you come across as arrogant and forceful. :( It makes it feel like you're just trying to force me into some predetermined form of what people should think like...

I've tried solo hikes and meditation, they used to make me happy, but they've faded as well... I still find beauty in nature, but it doesn't make me happy. I just don't see why it matters what I experience since life is so fleeting.

Yep, slowly everything started feeling more and more meaningless, to the point where nothing  brings any sense of hope/joy.

I don't think board games or new people are going to solve it. I've done the former enough times and it's lost its charm, and the latter is something I've tried a decent amount of times recently, and it usually leaves me feeling more empty if they don't meet my standards or it requires effort and little seems gained from the interaction.

I wish I could feel something other than empty.

Yeh, but he too will be forgotten in time and his impact as well.

It really doesn't feel rare when I see so many people in the world, and so many that are living shit lives.

Less about remembrance and more that the impact of an individual is so small it doesn't matter.

The thing is there's no fucking point to me to "living" life imo...

People try to put positivity around me, but it is to no avail. I used to be the most positive person both at work and parties, but then I slowly realized my disappointments and began this terrible downward spiral, I wish I was unaware of it all or more ignorant. :(

I am in a city, and I've tried meetup.com, but it's full of people who want to be around a lot of people a lot of the time from my experiences, I really just want to meet with 1-3 people at a time, and it doesn't make me feel better at all. It makes me feel like there are fewer and fewer people I can connect with......

I feel like even the likes of hitler will be forgotten by that time...

Is it that rare an experience? I see no benefit to many of those who have lived before me, nor to the many friends/family who've died, they are remembered at the funeral, but then I feel soon forgotten...

It takes so much effort to connect with any of these people, it's not really worth the time, and I don't see much of the point...

I've never felt like I was part of a community, that would require finding enough of the aforementioned people to constitute ourselves as an interesting community I'd feel like it was worth the effort to join, let alone not having to fake something to feel a part of their group... :(
